item.text: {"groups":[{"member_ids":["8b24b4cb96688979807f","ae1acd2c90805a0b718e","dcd841775fab7459a209","1ad1d626fc8a797ad73a"],"operation":"ParseFromString parses a four-component OBJ v line through LoadObj.","condition":"The v line has a fourth component representing a vertex weight.","capability":"Store and publish that component in vertex_weights.","consequence":"The vertex weight is lost or absent from vertex_weights.","equivalence_reason":"All four describe the same fourth-component parsing and output behavior."},{"member_ids":["8223b9b9211883698acc","a90ba499dcabf01f784a","4ca573f4c056f4f2f934","0be7cbf65c427e276994"],"operation":"ParseFromString parses an OBJ vertex without RGB components.","condition":"config.vertex_color=false.","capability":"Accept the vertex while leaving fallback colors absent.","consequence":"The vertex cannot be handled with fallback colors disabled, or fallback colors are supplied.","equivalence_reason":"All four target the same disabled vertex-color fallback behavior."},{"member_ids":["0e87590cf03d76f5fedf","05a946dded8ffaa7454b","e27058163c43296c596c","94ca956da1e3d51fa3f3"],"operation":"ParseFromString exports a polygon face through exportGroupsToShape.","condition":"The face is a valid quad and config.triangulate=false.","capability":"Retain the quad as one four-vertex face.","consequence":"The quad is triangulated instead of retained as one face.","equivalence_reason":"All four target preservation of a polygon when triangulation is disabled."}]}
